comment: Blood Sun step 6d (design §14): a NESTED acquisition. 10 Swamps + 2 Mountains, opponent at 6: Grim Tutor for Diabolic Revelation; the Revelation is cast IN Grim's breakpoint continuation at X = 2 for both Lightning Bolts (its resolution is a second, nested breakpoint), then both Bolts off the two Mountains -- the only this-turn kill. Before 6d the deferred re-solve loop discarded the continuation's re-arm, so the Bolts were never re-decided this phase: win turn 5 at any budget. MTG_BLOODSUN_USER_PRUNE=0 (Bolt is not a USER target). d1, budget 0.
